caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a high back and armrests. The chair is predominantly brown and features detailed, ornate carvings along the upper and lower parts of the backrest, as well as on the armrests and legs. The backrest and seat are constructed with a woven cane panel, forming a mesh pattern that contrasts with the solid wood frame. The armrests are wide, curving outward from the chair. The legs are turned and carved, connecting to side and front stretchers, which are also decorated with intricate scrollwork and motifs. The composition places the chair in three-quarter view on a plain, light background with faint perspective lines indicating depth.
title: Armchair
